arabic text: ROZAY PE MUSTAFA(SAWA) KE\nUDAASI SI CHAAYI HAI
english translation text: SADNESS PREVAILS IN THE\nSHRINE OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD (SAW)

arabic text: ROZAY PE MUSTAFA(SAWA) KE\nUDAASI SI CHAAYI HAI\nKUNBE KO KHOOKE ZAINAB(ASWS) E NASHAAAD AAYI HAI
english translation text: SADNESS PREVAILS IN THE SHRINE\nOF PROPHET MUHAMMAD (SAW) ZAINAB HAS\nARRIVED AFTER LOSING HER FAMILY

arabic text: AREY ROKAR PUKAARI NANA MAI....FARYAAD LAAYI HU\nMAI CHODKAR HUSSAIN(ASWS) KO JUNGLE MAI AAYI HU
english translation text: SHE CRIES OUT O GRANDFATHER;\nI HAVE COME HERE WITH A PLEA I HAVE LEFT HUSSAIN (A.S.) IN THE DESERT OF KARBALA

arabic text:
NANA AJEEB SAANAYE HUM PAR GUZAR GAYE
RANJO ALAM NE GHER LIYA HUM JIDHAR GAYE..
NANA KHUDA KE GHAR MAI NA HUMKO AAMA MILI
BHAAI NE SHEHER CHODKE JUNGLE KI RAAH LI..
english translation text:
O GRANDFATHER WE FACED STRANGE CALAMITIES GRIEF AND ANGUISH
SURROUNDED US WHEREVER WE WENT WE WERE DENIED REFUGE
IN THE HOUSE OF ALLAH MY BROTHER LEFT
THE CITY AND MADE HIS WAY TO THE DESERT

arabic text:
NANA HAMAARE GHAR KA SAB ASBAAB LUT GAYA...
NANA HAMAARE SAR PE NA BAAKI RAHI RIDAA
NANA HAZAAR TARHA JAFA KI LAEENO NE..
KHAIMO MAI HAAYE AAG LAGA DI LAEENO NE
english translation text:
O GRANDFATHER WE WERE LOOTED OF OUR
BELONGINGS GRANDFATHER OUR VEILS WERE SNATCHED GRANDFATHER
THE CURSED PEOPLE TORMENTED US IN A
HUNDRED WAYS OUR CAMPS WERE SET ABLAZE

arabic text:
NANA SHAHEED HO GAYE BHAAI KE JAA NISAAR...
EK EK KARKE MAR GAYE ASHAAB E ZEE WIQAR
NANA BALA KE BAN MAI QAYAMAT KA RAN PADAA
BHAAI SE BHAAI BAAP SE BETA BICHAD GAYAA
english translation text:
O GRANDFATHER ALL THE COMPANIONS OF MY BROTHER
WERE MARTYRED ONE BY ONE GRANDFATHER IT WAS
LIKE THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT IN KARBALA BROTHERS
LOST BROTHERS AND FATHERS LOST THEIR SONS

arabic text:
NANA ZAMEEN KARBOBALA LAAL HO GAYI...
QASIM(ASWS) KI LAASH GHODO SE PAAMAL HO GAI...
NANA KATAKE SHAANO KO ABBAS(ASWS) MAR GAYE....
GURBAT MAI BHAAIJAAN KO BE AAS KAR GAYE..
english translation text:
O GRANDFATHER THE SOIL OF KARBALA TURNED RED
THE BODY OF QASIM WAS MUTILATED BY HORSES
HOOVES GRANDFATHER ABBAS WAS MARTYRED AFTER HIS HANDS
WERE AMPUTATED AND HE LEFT MY BROTHER IN DISMAY

arabic text:
NANA ASEER BAARA THE AUR EK THI RASAN..
BAANDHE GAYE THE MISL E GUNAAH GAAR KHAS TATAN...
NANA HAM APNE HAAL PE
NANA HAMAARE HAAL PE HASTE THE BAD SHEYAAR.
english translation text:
ROTE THE BAAR BAAR.. O GRANDFATHER THERE WERE TWELVE PRISONERS
AND ONLY ONE ROPE TO TIE THEM WE WERE TIED
TOGETHER AS IF WE WERE SINNERS WE USED TO WEEP
AT OUR STATE BUT THE SCOUNDRELS USED TO LAUGH AT US

arabic text:
NANA TABAA HOKE HUM AAYE HAI SHAAM SE...
BALI SAKINA(ASWS) KHO KE HUM AAYE HAI SHAAM SE...
AB TAK HAI NEEL RASSI KE SHAANO KO DEKHLO..
NANA HAMAARE TAN PE NISHAANO KO DEKHLO
english translation text:
O GRANDFATHER WE HAVE RETURNED FROM SHAAM UTTERLY DEVASTATED
AND WE HAVE LOST SAKINA AS WELL YOU CAN
STILL SEE THE BRUISES OF ROPES ON OUR
SHOULDERS SEE THE SCARS ON OUR BODY O GRANDFATHER

arabic text:
ZAINAB(ASWS) JO ROKE KARTI THI QABR E NABI(SAWW) PE BEN...
THARRA RAHA THA ROZA E SULTAN E MASHRAKAIN (SAWW)...
BAS KHATM KAR NISAAR YE GHAM NAAK DASTAN
ROYE HAI IS ALAM MAI ZAMEE AUR AASMAAAA
english translation text:
ZAINAB MOURNED AT THE GRAVE OF THE PROPHET (SAW)
THE SHRINE OF THE KING OF THE WORLD WAS SHAKEN
O POET PLEASE STOP NARRATING THIS DEVASTATING STORY
EVEN THE SKY AND EARTH ARE CRYING OVER THIS TRAGEDY

arabic text:
HAS HASKE TAAZIYANE SITAM JHELTE RAHE
ITNE MAI EK SHAAMI NE NANA GAZAB KIYA...
SAIDAANI KO KANEEZI MAI USNE TALAB KIYA..
HOTI THI LAAKH ZILLATE HUM DEKHTE RAHE...
english translation text:
SMILING, WE CONTINUED TO ENDURE THE LASHES OF OPPRESSION
MEANWHILE, A MAN OF SHAAM COMMITTED A TERRIBLE OUTRAGE, O GRANDFATHER...
HE DEMANDED A SAYYIDA AS A SLAVE...
WE CONTINUED TO WITNESS COUNTLESS HUMILIATIONS...
